title: FTC's Endorsement Guides: What People Are Asking
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Guides revised in 2023; "affiliate link" alone not enough, "paid link" next to the link adequate; YouTube description-only disclosure not enough; disclose in video, spoken and shown; advertisers need reasonable programmes to train and monitor partners and should act on non-disclosure; monitor for a reasonable time after a contract; incentives cannot be conditioned on positive reviews

title: Disclosures 101 for Social Media Influencers
supports: Opened with WebFetch; dated November 2019. Material connections include free or discounted products; place disclosures with the endorsement; "ad", "advertisement", "sponsored"; say and show in video; repeat in live streams; avoid sp, spon, collab, ambassador, thanks; platform tools may not be enough alone

title: Federal Trade Commission announces final rule banning fake reviews and testimonials
supports: Opened with WebFetch; 14 Aug 2024. Bans fake reviews including AI-generated, sentiment-conditioned incentives, undisclosed insider reviews, review suppression, buying or selling fake followers or views to misrepresent influence; civil penalties for knowing violations

title: CSGO Lotto owners settle FTC's first-ever complaint against individual social media influencers
supports: Opened with WebFetch; 7 Sep 2017. Owners promoted their own site on YouTube without disclosure; other creators paid $2,500 to $55,000; settlement requires clear disclosure of material connections

title: Influencers' guide to making clear that ads are ads
publisher: Advertising Standards Authority and CAP (with the CMA)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Fourth edition dated 23 Oct 2026, first published 2018, developed with the CMA; adds fake consumer reviews, DMCC Act updates and CMA enforcement powers and penalties. Detail is in the linked PDF, which was not read

title: Recognising ads: Social media and influencer marketing
supports: Opened with WebFetch; dated 6 Aug 2026. When content is an ad (payment, gifts, commission, connection); reliable labels Ad, Advert, Advertising, Ad Feature; likely insufficient aff, sp, spon, affiliate, sponsored, gifted, thanks to; label upfront; YouTube identifier in title and/or thumbnail; brand at least jointly responsible for affiliate content

title: Affiliate marketing
supports: Opened with WebFetch; dated 22 Mar 2023. Affiliate content is advertising; brand and affiliate both responsible; labelling by format (blogs, vlogs, social, voucher sites); MailOnline "may earn an affiliate commission" disclaimer ruled insufficient

title: Social media endorsements: being transparent with your followers
supports: Opened with WebFetch; updated 3 Sep 2025. Incentives include money, commission, discounts and free products; labels clear, prominent and upfront (ad, advert, advertising); tagging, codes or affiliate links alone not enough; vague labels such as #gift, #collab, #spon, #aff not enough

title: Social media endorsements: guidance for brands
supports: Opened with WebFetch; updated 28 Aug 2025. Brands must make sure creators understand disclosure, give instructions with gifts, have a conduct policy, check content and act on unlabelled posts; repeat failures put the brand at risk; DMCC Act unfair commercial practices provisions from 6 Apr 2025

title: Reviews and social media endorsements: what businesses and content creators must know
supports: Opened with WebFetch. New law in force April 2025; CMA can issue fines and directions directly; fake reviews and concealed incentivised reviews are a banned practice; links to CMA guidance. Penalty amounts not stated on the page

title: Influencer Legal Hub
supports: Opened with WebFetch (no page date; legal briefs dated 11 Oct 2023). Brand partnerships and affiliate marketing must be disclosed; influencers who sell or advertise treated as traders; cites a 2025 Utrecht and Maastricht study (5.4% of posts labelled) and a 2018 Princeton study (10% of affiliate marketing on YouTube and Pinterest disclosed)

title: Review of EU consumer law (Digital Fairness Act)
supports: Opened with WebFetch (no page date). Digital Fairness Act "under preparation", covering among other issues misleading marketing by influencers; fitness check conclusions October 2024

title: Paid product placements and endorsements
supports: Opened with WebFetch (no page date). Paid Promotion setting in YouTube Studio; disclosure label at the start of the video; creators and partners must follow local law, with the FTC and ASA named

title: Advertising Standards (Branded content section)
supports: Opened with WebFetch (no page date). Ads promoting branded content must tag the featured business partner with the branded content tool

title: Awin and ShareASale unite to power global growth
supports: Opened with WebFetch; 14 Aug 2025. ShareASale customers moved to Awin; ShareASale closed 6 Oct 2025 with reports unavailable afterwards; Awin over 9,500 advertisers and 250,000 active publishers

title: Understanding commission validation
supports: Opened with WebFetch; updated 19 Oct 2026. Pending, approved and declined statuses; reasons to decline; programme validation periods; auto-validation when the period ends; amounts already paid cannot be reversed

title: Understanding cookies in affiliate marketing
supports: Opened with WebFetch; published 26 Mar 2026. Cookie period explained; "Industry standard is 30 days, but durations may vary by program"

title: Voucher code partners
supports: Opened with WebFetch; updated 14 Jul 2026. How voucher code partners work; exclusive, personalised and single-use codes give more control and tracking

title: Awin MCP overview
supports: Opened with WebFetch; updated 30 Sep 2026. Connector at mcp.awin.com for Claude and ChatGPT; sign in with Awin, no API token entered; acts with the user's permissions; advertiser reports need an API connection on Accelerate or Advanced plans

title: Tools available in Awin MCP
supports: Opened with WebFetch; updated 30 Sep 2026. Advertiser tools read account, partner and creative performance; the only write tool creates publisher tracking links after confirmation

title: Set action locking and payment scheduling periods
supports: Opened with WebFetch (no page date). Action locking (changes and reversals before lock; days-only up to 90 days) and payment scheduling (lock to payout, funds must cover the statement)

title: Learn about template terms and contracts
supports: Opened with WebFetch (no page date). Template terms set payouts and settings; a partner who accepts gets an individual contract; public, standard and non-standard terms (from a partner counter-proposal)

title: Brand MCP tools
supports: Opened with WebFetch (no page date). Brand MCP tools for performance, partners, recommendations, invoices and tasks are read-only by description; approving or declining applications stays in the platform interface

title: Associates Program Policies
supports: Opened with WebFetch; updated 14 Apr 2026. No incentives for clicks, no own purchases, no hidden or cloaked links, no bidding on Amazon marks; disclosure duties under rules such as the FTC Endorsement Guides

title: Associates Program Operating Agreement
supports: Opened with WebFetch; updated 15 Oct 2025. Either side may end with seven days' notice; accrued unpaid commissions may be held for a reasonable period after termination for cancellations or returns

title: Merchants FAQ: Managed Payouts
supports: Opened with WebFetch (no page date). The merchant funds each payout and Rewardful distributes it; affiliates give payout and tax or identity details during onboarding; methods vary by country

title: Trademarks policy
supports: Opened with WebFetch (no page date). Google does not restrict trademarks as keywords; restricts them in ad text from direct competitors or misleading uses after a complaint; reseller and informational site rules

title: Qualify your outbound links to Google
supports: Opened with WebFetch (no page date). rel="sponsored" for ads and paid placements; nofollow still accepted; ugc for user content

title: Chrome Web Store policy updates: affiliate programs in Chrome extensions
supports: Opened with WebFetch; 11 Mar 2025. From 10 Jun 2025 extensions may add affiliate links, codes or cookies only with a direct user benefit, a user action first and clear disclosure

title: Growing ConvertKit to $30,000 in monthly recurring revenue
supports: Opened with WebFetch; 15 Oct 2015. ConvertKit paid a 30% recurring commission, matching AWeber; most customers joined the affiliate programme; small commissions or credits do not motivate
